claim: Venice's day-tripper access fee returns in 2026, expanded to 60 peak days (April 3-July 26), at EUR5 booked four-plus days ahead or EUR10 last-minute.
quote: the fee is EUR5 per person if paid at least four days in advance, or EUR10 if paid closer to your visit ... valid on 60 days in 2026, from April 3 to July 26, 2026

claim: The Contributo di Accesso applies to day visitors over 14 to Venice's historic centre, with exemptions for overnight guests, residents, students, workers and the disabled.
quote: There are exceptions for children under the age of 14, those staying in Venice overnight, people with disabilities and residents of Venice

claim: Anti-tourism protests planned coordination across multiple European cities in 2026, spreading beyond Spain, with housing displacement the core grievance.
quote: With coordinated demonstrations planned across multiple European cities in 2026, many of those tensions are set to return.

claim: Spain ranks first of 30 countries for anti-tourism sentiment, with protests in over 40 cities from Barcelona to the Canary Islands.
quote: Spain ranks first among 30 countries analyzed for anti-tourism sentiment, with protests registered in more than 40 cities nationwide, from Barcelona to the Canary Islands

claim: On 15 June 2025 thousands marched through central Barcelona chanting 'Your holidays, my misery,' using water pistols and smoke devices.
quote: thousands of residents marched through central neighbourhoods chanting slogans such as "Your holidays, my misery", with some protesters using water pistols and smoke devices

claim: Edinburgh introduces a 5% visitor levy on accommodation (capped at five nights) from 24 July 2026, the UK's first such tax, projected to raise up to GBP50 million a year.
quote: If you are planning to stay in Edinburgh on or after 24 July 2026 ... a 5% visitor levy charge will be added to your accommodation cost ... capped at the first five nights

claim: The Edinburgh Fringe Society predicts the visitor levy will raise over GBP6.5 million annually toward cultural and arts events.
quote: the Edinburgh Festival Fringe Society ... predicts the levy will raise over GBP6.5 million annually, which will go towards supporting the ongoing growth of cultural and arts events

claim: Oktoberfest 2025 lost an estimated EUR21.2 million after a bomb threat shut the Theresienwiese grounds for hours, against typical EUR1.57 billion revenue.
quote: As a result of the closure caused by the bomb scare, Oktoberfest this year is on course to lose EUR21.2 million.

claim: Oktoberfest's grounds were closed for a police security sweep on 1 October 2025 after a bomb threat linked to a deadly explosion in northern Munich.
quote: The Oktoberfest fairgrounds closed for several hours Wednesday as police conducted a security sweep of the famed beer festival due to a bomb threat

claim: La Tomatina caps participation at 20,000 ticketed attendees (since 2013) with mandatory EUR15 wristbands for 2026, after a 2012 crowd of ~50,000 raised safety concerns.
quote: Since 2013, official ticketing limits participation to 20,000 people ... Standard tickets go for EUR15 per person for 2026

claim: Fujiyoshida cancelled its Arakurayama Sengen Park cherry blossom festival (nearly 200,000 visitors/year) over overtourism crowds threatening residents.
quote: Behind [Mount Fuji's] beautiful landscape is the reality that the quiet lives of citizens are threatened.

claim: Multiple 2026 music festivals were cancelled for financial reasons, including Cardiff's debut We Are One and Illinois' Summer Camp Music Festival.
quote: Summer Camp Music Festival will not take place on May 21-24, 2026 ... cancellation was due to "unforeseen financial circumstances involving a third-party service provider"
